summary.en: Decompose a registration sheet through normal forms and verify the repaired tables in MySQL.
summary.bn: একটি রেজিস্ট্রেশন টেবিল ধাপে ধাপে ভেঙে 1NF, 2NF ও 3NF বানাও।

notes: InnoDB and enforced CHECK constraints are used; MySQL 8.0.16 or later is required.

sections.title: Write the relation and its dependencies
Observe the anomaly and its repair
Give each changing fact one home

examples.title: Expose a partial update
examples.explanationHtml: One row says CSE renamed while two other rows retain the old department name. A partial update breaks the intended department rule without violating the flat table’s structure.

examples.title: Update the authoritative department
examples.explanationHtml: The department name changes once. All three joined registrations show the same new value, and rollback restores the teaching data.

examples.title: Keep course facts after the last registration
examples.explanationHtml: The course remains even when section 31 has no registrations. Separate course storage removes the deletion anomaly; the transaction restores enrollments and cascaded results.

practice.title: Change one course title
practice.statementHtml: Change course 21 to Database Systems, show its joined offerings, then roll back and show its original title.
hints: The title belongs to courses, not to each offering.

practice.title: Insert an independent course
practice.statementHtml: Insert course 26 with code CSE 300, title Design, credits 3 and department 1; show it has zero sections; roll back and confirm its absence.
hints: LEFT JOIN preserves the new course without any offering.

practice.title: Reach 3NF
practice.statementHtml: For R(S,C,N,D,H,T,M), F = {S → ND,D → H,C → T,SC → M}, show keys and all decomposition stages.
hints: Separate student facts, then department facts.
practice.answerHtml: SC is the only key because neither S nor C is derivable. 2NF gives SNDH, CT and SCM. 3NF splits SNDH into SND and DH. The final SND, DH, CT, SCM retain each FD locally. The intersections S, D and C determine their separated component, so every split is lossless.

practice.title: Explain an insertion anomaly
practice.statementHtml: A flat (student_id,course_id,course_title) table uses the pair as key. Why is a new course difficult to record?
hints: Do not invent a student to satisfy a course requirement.
practice.answerHtml: No student-course pair exists yet, so a complete key cannot be supplied for the course fact alone. A separate Course(course_id,course_title) relation records the course before enrollment. Registration then references its course key.

practice.title: Respect a retake policy
practice.statementHtml: Students may take the same course twice in different semesters. Is (student_id,course_id) sufficient?
hints: Normal forms cannot decide which real event you intended.
practice.answerHtml: No. The pair would reject a valid second attempt or overwrite the first. Include a section or attempt identifier with the student. Then restate the FDs and repeat normal-form analysis for that event key.

quiz.prompt: How many title rows store course 21 before any offering join?
quiz.code: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM courses WHERE course_id = 21;

quiz.prompt: How many offerings reference the single course-21 fact?
quiz.code: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sections WHERE course_id = 21;
quiz.explanation: Two offerings share one course row.

quiz.prompt: How many department rows supply the name for all CSE students?
quiz.code: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM departments WHERE department_id = 1;
quiz.explanation: A department description has one authoritative row.

quiz.prompt: What makes SC → Mark a full dependency in the stated registration model?
options: Neither S nor C alone determines Mark
Mark determines both S and C
quiz.explanation: The mark belongs to one registration pair.

quiz.prompt: Which split removes C → Title from a table keyed by SC?
quiz.explanation: The course key determines its title.

quiz.prompt: Which 3NF exception concerns an FD with a nonkey left side?
options: Its right attribute may be any nonprime column
The table has a surrogate id
Its right attribute may be prime
quiz.explanation: Formal 3NF checks superkey determinants or prime results.

quiz.prompt: What does a joined department-name update avoid?
quiz.explanation: Department descriptions have one stored home.

quiz.prompt: Why does a new row_id leave normalisation unfinished?
options: Every table requires a composite key
quiz.explanation: A new identifier does not eliminate the business FDs.

quiz.prompt: Which property prevents extra registration rows after a split?
quiz.explanation: A lossless join reconstructs precisely the original relation.

quiz.prompt: What must be analysed when candidate keys overlap?
quiz.explanation: Prime attributes and partial dependencies depend on all candidate keys.

keyPoints.en: Normalisation moves each fact to the key that determines it.
keyPoints.bn: নরমালাইজেশনে প্রতিটি তথ্য তাকে নির্ধারণ করা কি-এর কাছে রাখো।

keyPoints.en: 1NF removes repeating groups within the chosen attribute domains.
keyPoints.bn: 1NF করতে একই ঘরে রাখা একাধিক মান আলাদা সারিতে নাও।

keyPoints.en: 2NF removes partial dependencies of nonprime attributes on candidate keys.
keyPoints.bn: 2NF-এ nonprime অ্যাট্রিবিউট candidate key-এর শুধু এক অংশের ওপর নির্ভর করে না।

keyPoints.en: 3NF permits a nonkey determinant only when the determined attribute is prime.
keyPoints.bn: 3NF-এ determinant superkey না হলে ডান পাশের অ্যাট্রিবিউট prime হতে হবে।

keyPoints.en: A safe split needs a lossless join and checks for dependency preservation.
keyPoints.bn: টেবিল ভাঙার পর lossless join আর FD ঠিক আছে কি না যাচাই করো।
